title: Salvation
definition: Salvation is God’s gracious rescue of sinners from sin, judgment, death, and separation from Him through the person and work of Jesus Christ.
summary: Salvation includes forgiveness, justification, adoption, sanctification, perseverance, and future glorification. It is received by grace through faith, not earned by works.
christFocus: Salvation is in Christ alone. The believer’s confidence rests in His life, death, resurrection, and ongoing intercession.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Salvation is applied by the Holy Spirit and received through faith.
